transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started with the round-robin updates before I publish tomorrow's task-organization order. We need to cover airfield operations, signal, and medical planning in that order. Airfield ops, you're up first — please give us your current qualifications and any updates for tomorrow's airfield fuel sampling. Signal, be ready to follow with your report on radio-cable inspection readiness. Medical, you'll close us out with clinic-generator testing status. Once I've recorded all updates, I'll issue the binding order assigning Red, Blue, and Gold teams to their respective tasks for the 0800-1200 work period.
